title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site update
author: Liam Walker
commits: Initial RAG templates and agent quickstart drafts
Add tool-calling example notebooks and TypeScript sample
Docs site: new quickstarts index and sidebar entries
Fix linting and doc build issues, update images
description:
Context: provide first-class RAG quickstarts and agent/tool-calling examples so developers can onboard to Redwood's RAG + agent patterns quickly. Motivation: many customers ask for end-to-end examples (template ingestion -> simple agent -> tool-calling) and docs that show recommended runtime config and quality tradeoffs. This PR adds curated templates, runnable examples in Python and TypeScript, supporting notebooks for tool-calling, and updates the docs site sidebar and quickstarts index.

What changed: consolidated RAG templates under redwood-examples/templates/rag, added a Python quickstart that demonstrates document ingestion, vector store creation, and an agent loop using the new agent SDK helpers; added a TypeScript quickstart mirroring the flow; included a Jupyter notebook that shows tool-calling examples (external API lookup + small calculator tool) and instructions for local testing; updated docs/_sidebar.yml and docs/quickstarts/index.md to expose the new quickstarts; fixed image paths and added a small architecture diagram.

Testing and validation: ran docs build locally, CI docs pipeline and unit tests. Addressed an initial docs-build failure caused by a missing asset path. Verified examples run against a local redwood dev stack and against hosted API with a demo API key.

Checklist:
- [x] Add templates and examples (Python, TypeScript, notebook)
- [x] Update docs site and sidebar
- [x] CI: docs build passes after fixes
- [x] Add short readmes for each example and copy edits

Notes: removed a couple of internal-only example keys; examples use public sample data and include instructions for swapping in customer datasets. No runtime or API contract changes were made in this PR (docs + examples only).
